title: Pavement Repair
agency: AGRICULTURE, DEPARTMENT OF.ANIMAL AND PLANT HEALTH INSPECTION SERVICE.MRPBS MINNEAPOLIS MN
description_text: The entire paved area at the Memphis Cotton Classing Facility is in a severe state of disrepair and must be replaced. The surfaces were first paved in 1995. There is poor drainage and water intrusion to the subbase, leading to severe degradation. Solicitation documents are posted below.
